versions.changelog: 更新：验证码图片保存+发送流程、关闭浏览器、踩坑记录完善

Initial release with full automation of 12321 phone harassment reporting through browser and chat interaction.

- Supports step-by-step automated filling of the 12321 harassment phone report form.
- Includes bypassing web countdown, captcha recognition, and interactive confirmation of all fields before submission.
- Allows users to modify any field and confirm before proceeding.
- Handles SMS verification and all required detail entry in sequence, with field defaults and mapping.
- Submits the report and notifies user of success or next steps on error.
